title: The Safehouse of Kowloon
author: Isandro Ashgrove
blurb: Ada Villalobos, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
